description: This file defines the ToyVpnConnection class, which manages VPN tunnel connections including setup, handshake, packet forwarding, keepalive handling, and re-establishment logic for a VPN service in an Android application.

classes.name: ToyVpnConnection
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle and data transfer over a VPN connection, including connection establishment, packet forwarding, ICMP handling, and reconnection logic.

classes.name: ToyVpnConnection.OnEstablishListener
classes.description: Callback interface to notify when a VPN connection has been established with the underlying interface.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method of the connection thread; attempts to establish connection to VPN server and handle data transfer.

methods.name: setConfigureIntent
methods.description: Sets an optional PendingIntent for configuring the VPN.

methods.name: setOnEstablishListener
methods.description: Registers a callback listener invoked upon successful VPN interface establishment.

methods.name: handshake
methods.description: Performs the handshake with the server to authenticate and establish secure parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the VPN interface using parameters received from the server handshake.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns a string identifier used for logging.
